name: vwap_mean_reversion_v18
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, sharp intraday selloffs push the index 40-80 spot points below session VWAP. At this deviation level, every VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithm starts accumulating aggressively — they are getting fills significantly better than their benchmark price. The resulting demand surge is visible at 5-second resolution as the rate of deviation slowing down (dev_momentum turning positive) before the actual reversal begins, giving 15-30 seconds of lead time to enter before the bounce.

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume) from session open
indicators.purpose: No scaling needed — cumulative session VWAP has no lookback. It captures the institutional benchmark that algo orders are measured against. Resets at each day's open (09:15 IST).

indicators.name: vwap_dev
indicators.purpose: Raw deviation from VWAP in NIFTY spot points. Large negative values (below -25 pts) indicate the index has overshot its fair value and VWAP-benchmarked buyers should start lifting.

indicators.name: vwap_stddev_360
indicators.purpose: 30-minute (360 bar × 5s) rolling standard deviation of VWAP deviation. NOT the original's full-day window. 30-min captures the current session's volatility regime (opening hour vs afternoon drift are different) without being so short that it compresses in quiet periods. Used to normalize dev into a z-score for threshold setting.

indicators.name: vwap_zscore
indicators.purpose: Normalized deviation. Original used 21-bar STDDEV on 15-min equity bars. At 5s on NIFTY we use 360 bars (30 min) because the index has much lower noise-to-signal than individual stocks — we need more history to distinguish a genuine institutional-level deviation from normal intraday chop.

indicators.name: dev_momentum_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute (24 bar × 5s) change in VWAP deviation. REPLACES rel_volume from the original because NIFTY index volume is noisy — volume surges can be program-driven with no directional intent. dev_momentum > 0 for buy_ce means the deviation is shrinking (price is recovering toward VWAP), confirming the thesis rather than the entry being into a continuing flush.

buy_ce.confirmation: Deviation turning less negative over last 2 minutes confirms institutional buying has started; avoids entering into a deepening flush

buy_pe.confirmation: Deviation turning less positive over last 2 minutes confirms institutional selling has started; avoids entering into a continuing overshoot

exit.stop_rationale: 6 option points because NIFTY VWAP reversion trades need room for the final flush before bounce — a 12 spot-point adverse move (6 option pts at delta 0.5) is within normal noise on a genuine 40-80 spot point deviation, and tighter stops get shaken out before the reversion begins.
exit.target_rationale: 10 option points because deep deviations (1.7+ sigma from VWAP) revert 50-70% to mean over 30-120 seconds; 10 pts = ~20 spot point reversion, capturing the lower end of the typical first-leg (1:1.67 R:R vs 6pt stop).

filters.vix_filter: none (VIX filter removed — NIFTY VWAP deviations are larger on high-VIX days, which is when the strategy works best)
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST only (skip first 5 minutes of pre-open noise)
filters.trend_filter: none (mean reversion works regardless of trend direction)
filters.spread_filter: state machine handles via premium validity check

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — behavioral; VWAP benchmarking is structural for Indian institutions

adaptation_notes: Original was a cross-sectional equity strategy on Nifty200 stocks at 15-min bars. Key changes: (1) Universe → NIFTY index only; 5-second bars; (2) VWAP → session cumulative (no lookback change needed since cumulative); (3) 21-bar equity STDDEV (21×15min=5hrs) → 360-bar 5s STDDEV (30 min) to capture current regime not full day; (4) rel_volume filter → dev_momentum_24 because index volume is noisy and momentum of deviation is more reliable; (5) Hold time compressed from 30-60 bars (15min bars) to 30-120 seconds; (6) ATR-based stop → 6 option points (NIFTY-specific calibration to typical flush depth).
weaknesses: Trending NIFTY days with persistent gap from VWAP will cause multiple stop-outs
Sharp macro news (RBI, US CPI) can cause deviation without reversion
On expiry days, gamma effects dominate VWAP benchmarking logic
Low-liquidity afternoon sessions may have wide option spreads reducing edge
